About Oshana Security

Protecting the North Since 1995

Founded in Oshakati in 1995 and now headquartered in Ongwediva, Oshana Security is one of northern Namibia's leading security providers.

We train our own officers and respond around the clock across the Oshana, Omusati, Ohangwena, Oshikoto and Kunene regions.

Our Story

Rooted in Northern Namibia

Oshana Security opened its doors in Oshakati in 1995 to give businesses and families in the north a security partner that understood the region. Today our head office is at 5470 Elyambala, Ongwediva, and our teams cover towns from Outapi to Eenhana and Opuwo.

We offer guarding, armed response, cash in transit, alarm monitoring, CCTV off-site monitoring and technical installations, backed by our own firearm academy and indoor range.

Corporate Social Responsibility

Giving Back to the Communities We Protect

Housing, education and winter relief for the people of northern Namibia.

Stories of Giving

Where We've Made a Difference

A truly secure community is one where people have a home, an education and warmth in winter. These are the stories behind our giving.

Standard Bank Buy a Brick

Every brick is someone's future front door.

Since 2018 we have given N$50,000 every year to the Standard Bank Buy a Brick initiative. Working with the Shack Dwellers Federation of Namibia, it turns donations into bricks, and bricks into homes for families who have waited years for a safe place to live.

For a security company, a locked front door is where safety starts. Helping families get one is the most direct way we know to protect a community.

N$50,000 every year since 2018 In partnership with the Shack Dwellers Federation of Namibia
NUST Eenhana Campus

A proud day for the graduates of the north.

Graduation is the moment years of hard work pay off, for students and for the families who sacrificed to get them there. We supported the NUST Eenhana graduation ceremony so that day could be celebrated the way it deserves.

Many of those graduates will build their careers right here in the north, and we are proud to stand behind them from the first step.

Education
Ongwediva Town Council Winter Drive

No one should face a northern winter night without a blanket.

When the cold months arrived, we donated blankets to the Ongwediva Town Council's winter drive. They went to struggling mothers, young children and people living on the streets of the town we call home.

It is a simple gift, but on a cold night it matters more than almost anything else.

Community Welfare

Want to Partner With Us?

If your organisation is involved in community upliftment across northern Namibia, we would love to hear from you.
